roleLabel: Late-fight Mystic support — Shields, heals, and Stall-powered resurrection
bestFor: Difficult fights and Red-Rift style pressure where someone must clutch the lowest HP hero or revive after Stall
strength: Salvation targets the most desperate ally and can resurrect after Stall — unique panic button other Mystics lack
weakness: Slow to pay off if fights end before Stall thresholds; weak as an early solo damage hero

howToPlay.early: Draft Grace when you already have damage and keep whiting out. Mana Regen first so Salvation actually casts.
howToPlay.mid: Selfless = team-wide Salvation after Stall (plus Backup shields). Benevolent = permanent primary stats on cast after Stall. Radiant = Mystics’ Shields grant Attack/Magic. Pick based on whether you need clutch peels, permanent stacks, or team damage amp.
howToPlay.late: Lean into Stall relics and Mystic Shield banners. Her power spike is mid-to-late fight — do not judge her on the first five seconds.
howToPlay.positioning: Mid-back with vision on both frontliners. She must be alive when Stall windows open or the resurrect clause never matters.

abilityNotes.Salvation: Lowest % HP targeting is automatic triage. After Stall (5) it can resurrect — surviving into Stall is part of the build, not optional flavor.

specNotes.The Selfless: Team peel path — Salvation hits everyone after Stall, with strong Backup-only team Shields. Take for sticky, Stall-heavy clears.
specNotes.The Benevolent: Permanent stat gifts on Stall casts. Take when you want Grace to scale a chosen carry across the run.
specNotes.The Radiant: Whenever Mystics Shield, grant Attack and Magic. Take on multi-Mystic Shield boards.

relicReasons.mystics-barrier-banner-585: More Shield uptime for the job she already does.
relicReasons.mystics-prosperity-filigree-3012: Helps cast frequency so Salvation is ready when someone dips.
relicReasons.arcane-backup-prism-3051: Backup-friendly arcane tool — pairs with Selfless/Radiant Backup text.

faq.question: Is Grace good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: One of the best clutch supports in hard content. Mediocre if you need early clear and never reach Stall. Buy her to stop dying, not to speed-clear Act 1.

faq.question: What class is Grace?
faq.answer: Mystic. Role focus: late-fight Shields, healing, and Stall-enabled resurrection.

faq.question: What relics work with Grace?
faq.answer: Mystic Barrier/Prosperity pieces, Stall enablers, and Backup/arcane tools if you took Selfless or Radiant.

faq.question: How do you play Grace?
faq.answer: Keep her alive into Stall, cast Salvation on collapsing allies, and specialize toward team peel (Selfless), permanent buffs (Benevolent), or Mystic damage amp (Radiant).

tips: If fights end before Stall 5, Grace’s resurrect never shows — add Stall or slow the clear intentionally on bosses.
She does not replace a tank; she saves the tank.
